### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>pkg/sftp (github.com/pkg/sftp)</summary>

### [`v1.13.12`](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/releases/tag/v1.13.12)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/compare/v1.13.11...v1.13.12)

#### What's Changed

- fix flaky TestClientStatVFS on macOS by [@​drakkan](https://redirect.github.com/drakkan) in [#​666](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/666)
- harden client reply parsers against malformed server replies by [@​drakkan](https://redirect.github.com/drakkan) in [#​655](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/655)
- fix flaky TestRequestStatVFS by [@​christhomas](https://redirect.github.com/christhomas) in [#​676](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/676)
- return write error for short final chunk in File.ReadFrom by [@​christhomas](https://redirect.github.com/christhomas) in [#​670](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/670)
- reject hardlink and create/truncate opens on a read-only server by [@​likitha011](https://redirect.github.com/likitha011) in [#​682](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/682)
- server: do not dispatch packets that failed to unmarshal by [@​likitha011](https://redirect.github.com/likitha011) in [#​694](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/694)
- return the reader's io.ErrUnexpectedEOF from File.ReadFrom by [@​christhomas](https://redirect.github.com/christhomas) in [#​674](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/674)
- \[v1] send exit-status from the example servers by [@​christhomas](https://redirect.github.com/christhomas) in [#​686](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/686)

#### New Contributors

- [@​likitha011](https://redirect.github.com/likitha011) made their first contribution in [#​682](https://redirect.github.com/pkg/sftp/pull/682)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/pkg/sftp/compare/v1.13.11...v1.13.12>

</details>
